Composible Chaos

Composible Chaos · 8 weeks

Flexible workouts. Daily habits. Your rhythm.

Do each of these five workouts twice a week. Each block takes about 25 minutes. Stack a few together or spread them out around your week.

    Two daily habits: cardio, and nutrition (225g protein + calories tracked). Complete all 10 workouts and all 14 daily habits to celebrate each week.

    Each week is seven days from your chosen start date, not a Monday-to-Sunday timetable. That's 10 blocks per week, 80 across your commitment. If you start in the future, check-offs stay locked until your start date: that is by design, not a fault.

    Daily habits

    Cardio every day. Nutrition: 225g protein + calories tracked.

    Future days unlock on their date. Workouts stay flexible throughout the week. Your weekly celebration needs all 10 workouts and all 14 habits.

    Tick a block after you finish it. Untick to undo. Check-offs track your commitment; use Workout separately if you want to log sets and earn XP.
